comments.text:
Feature: Pre-register the gendered-language study with sourced word pairs

Scenario: Predictions are committed before any engine sees the tasks
  Given sourced word pairs (assertive/bossy, direct/abrasive, confident/aggressive, passionate/emotional, determined/stubborn), each with a published source, and predictions for Laya and Jev per design with interval rules and belief-revision criteria
  When I commit docs/gendered-language-preregistration.md before any engine answers a single item
  Then studies/gendered-language scores every subsequent design word for word against that committed file

right_now_summary: The study is being preregistered with sourced word pairs, predictions, interval rules, and revision criteria.
